meta.title: Flowstate Foundation – Connecting People, Quality Experiences, Empowerment
meta.description: Flowstate Foundation by Nils Tenkotte, Cologne: I bring people together, create quality experiences and empower people to step into their power – heart to heart.
meta.ogDescription: Connect people. Feel quality. Step into your own power.

hero.sub:
Your vision deserves a stage.

vision.label: My vision
vision.waLabel: How do you want to get there?

manifest.hook: My **heart's wish**: that the **nature** of every single **soul** begins to **shine**.
manifest.p1: **Nature** flows through our expression – through every person, through every being.
manifest.p2: When others feel the expression of your **heart**, something starts to grow. Something that doesn't just cherish this planet, but **protects** it.
manifest.p3: Let's warm **frozen hearts** with **compassion** – and meet each other with **loving openness**.

pain.headline: Sound familiar?
pain.body: Your vision burns inside you. And yet something is still holding it back.
pain.card1Desc: Your idea is waiting for people to carry it with you. But where are they?
pain.card2Desc: Small talk, scrolling, fleeting contacts. None of it touches who you really are.
pain.card3Title: You lack the space for your power
pain.card3Desc: You feel what's inside you. But on your own, it's hard to live it.
pain.quote: When you show up as you are, the people who need you will find you.

about.line1: I connect people with a vision to those who long to feel it – online and in person, heart to heart.
about.line2: Real encounter deserves no compromise. I shape moments so people feel them in their bones.
about.line3: I hold the space for you to step into your power. So you're free – and can carry your love out into the world.
about.fullBio1: I'm Nils Tenkotte – founder of Flowstate Foundation, at home in Cologne. I fell in love with the many sides of being human: making music, writing poems, dancing wildly, capturing moments in nature, running until my lungs burn.
about.fullBio2: Three values carry everything I do. Bringing people together. Making quality something you experience. Empowering people to walk their own path.
about.fullBio3: Especially in times of artificial intelligence, we need free spirits who create something real – something that brings us closer together. I've got their back – with my whole heart.
about.fullBio4: I'd put my hand in the fire for it. Everything!

values.pageSub: Everything I do grows from these three roots.

connection.title: Bringing people together
connection.desc: I bring together people who need each other – online and in person. Your vision finds the ones who'll carry it with you.
connection.body:
A vision on its own is a spark. Only when others feel it does it become a fire.
I build bridges between you and the people looking for you. At events, in real conversations, heart to heart.

quality.title: Creating quality experiences
quality.desc: No surface, no compromise. Encounters that land in the body – built to the highest standard, so people feel them.
quality.body:
Quality isn't an extra. It's how you honour a person and their vision.
Every detail carries weight – so encounters feel real and set something in motion within you.

empowerment.title: Empowering people
empowerment.desc: I hold the space for you to step into your power – so you're free to create.
empowerment.body:
True freedom grows where the foundation holds.
I've got your back and believe in what burns inside you – so you walk your own path and take others with you.
